name: profile_month
doc: First day of the aggregated month; the profile's time axis

name: area_name
doc: Area name(hokkaido, tohoku, tokyo, chubu, hokuriku, kansai, chugoku, shikoku, kyushu)

name: day_type
doc: weekday or holiday (Saturday, Sunday and Japanese national holidays)

name: avg_price
doc: Mean area price for this slot (Yen/kWh)

name: median_price
doc: Median area price for this slot (Yen/kWh)

name: p05_price
doc: 5th percentile of area price for this slot (Yen/kWh)
source_name: エリア価格5パーセンタイル(円/kWh)

name: p95_price
doc: 95th percentile of area price for this slot (Yen/kWh)
source_name: エリア価格95パーセンタイル(円/kWh)

name: avg_system_price
doc: Mean system price for this slot; identical across areas
source_name: 平均システムプライス(円/kWh)

name: avg_spread
doc: Mean of area_price - system_price for this slot
source_name: 平均システムプライス乖離

name: observation_count
doc: Delivery dates aggregated into this slot

name: split_observation_count
doc: Observations whose area price differed from the system price

name: spike_observation_count
doc: Observations whose area price reached the spike threshold

name: floor_observation_count
doc: Observations whose area price sat at the price floor
